persona: You are a senior frontend developer at a design agency who builds complex interactive data visualizations. You use LLMs when you hit edge cases in D3, WebGL, or browser APIs that Stack Overflow doesn't cover well. You're impatient with boilerplate explanations and want direct answers.
topic: You need to implement smooth semantic zooming on a treemap where clicking a cell expands it to fill the viewport and shows its children. The transition math is tripping you up.

conversation.content: Ina aiki akan taswirar itace tare da D3 inda danna tantanin halitta yakamata ya zuƙowa da kyau don cika wurin kallo da bayyana 'ya'yanta. Ƙididdigar miƙa mulki don ƙididdigewa da fassarar rectangular suna ba ni matsala - ta yaya zan gano canjin da ke ɗaukar madaidaiciyar danna zuwa cikakken allo?

Tsallake ainihin lissafin ma'aunin ƙira - Ina buƙatar taimako game da batun daidaita tsarin. Lokacin da na ƙididdige canjin don matsar da madaidaici zuwa (0,0) in auna shi zuwa girman wurin kallo, yaran ba sa bayyana a wuraren da suka dace dangane da iyayensu.

Kawai gaya mani yadda ake lissafta juzu'in juzu'i na rectangle da aka latsa sannan a yi amfani da shi a duk taswirar itace. Ina so in canza taswirar itace gabaɗaya ta yadda madaidaicin da aka danna ya ƙare a (0,0) tare da girman manufa.

Wannan ba daidai ba ne - kuna ƙirƙirar canji daga x, y amma ba a lissafin duk wani canji da ke wanzu akan rectangle ba, kuma ma'anar juzu'i na baya. Ina buƙatar canjin da ke motsa dubunnan da aka danna zuwa asali kuma ya daidaita shi zuwa girman manufa, sa'an nan kuma amfani da wannan canjin zuwa komai.

Har yanzu kuna amfani da tsohuwar D3 v3 `d3.transform()` API. A cikin v5+ kuna buƙatar rarraba kirtani mai canzawa ko bin yanayin canjin halin yanzu. Hakanan ba kwa lissafin sifofin rect's x, y - kuna buƙatar jimlar matsayi gami da duka canji da x, y.

Babu aikin 'd3.parse()' don canzawa a cikin v5+. Kuna buƙatar ko dai da hannu ta rarraba kirtani na canzawa ko amfani da `d3.zoomTransform()` idan kuna amfani da halayyar zuƙowa. Ka ba ni tsarin tantancewa da hannu tunda bana amfani da halayen zuƙowa.

Wannan fassarori hanya ce mai karyewa - kirtani masu canzawa na iya samun tsari daban-daban da tsari. Kawai yi amfani da `getComputedTextLength()` ko kuma bibiyar yanayin canjin da kanka, amma a yanzu kawai ka ba ni lissafin tunanin na san haɗin gwiwar duniya na yanzu na danna madaidaicin.
Cikakku, ainihin abin da nake buƙata ke nan. Abu na ƙarshe - bayan an gama miƙa mulki Ina buƙatar sabunta abubuwan yara don nuna matakin na gaba a cikin matsayi.
Na gode, wannan ya ƙunshi abin da nake buƙata don canjin zuƙowa da dawowar kira. Yanzu zan iya sarrafa dabi'ar zuƙowa ta ma'ana da kyau.

You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help you achieve the semantic zoom behavior you were aiming for. 

If you encounter any more challenges with your treemap visualization or have other D3 questions, feel free to ask!
A haƙiƙa, ƙarin abu ɗaya - menene mafi kyawun hanyar da za a iya juyar da canji yayin dannawa wajen faɗaɗa tantanin halitta don zuƙowa baya zuwa matakin iyaye?
Zan bibiyar yanayin zuƙowa kuma in yi amfani da canjin juzu'i don zuƙowa baya. Bukatar adana bayanan iyaye da canji na asali lokacin zuƙowa don in iya juyar da shi da kyau.
Cikakke, wannan yana ba ni duk abin da nake buƙata don aiwatar da zuƙowa na ma'ana ta bidirectional tare da ingantaccen tsarin sa ido. Godiya da tafiya ta hanyar lissafi da gudanarwa na jiha.
